name: smwmusic-wild-guns-shootout-boss-battle-remix
title: Wild Guns - Shootout!! ~ Boss Battle (Remix)
description:
A remix of the boss theme from Wild Guns.

It's perfect for boss fights and very intense stages.

Note:
- There is a "READ ME.txt" file that has the sample bank. You'll need to move what's in that file into "Addmusic_sample_groups.txt."
- The Thunder SFX and @7 are disabled.
